verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents a dedicated 'Oneleet Auditor API' with 25 paths and its own reference page. That shows a first-party, auditor-specific way to reach workspace data, but the evidence never describes an in-platform auditor UI where auditors review controls and evidence, or how that access is scoped. Custom RBAC roles are a related control, not an auditor view, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented auditor portal or view in the platform, scoping of auditor access to specific controls and evidence, an in-platform auditor review or request workflow replacing email, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my auditor works directly in the platform — a scoped auditor view of controls and evidence replaces email threads of PDFs
